_about: Food data sources (D-037). `backend/fooddata/download.py` downloads each file into data/raw/ (not committed) and fills in sha256/size/downloaded_at here, so we can prove exactly which file every food came from.

sources.name: USDA FoodData Central - SR Legacy
sources.credit: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central. fdc.nal.usda.gov

sources.name: McCance and Widdowson's Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset (CoFID) 2021
sources.credit: Public Health England (2021). McCance and Widdowson's The Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset 2021. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

_not_used.reason: Checked 2026-11-05: this release has no food.csv / food_nutrient.csv (per-food values), only lab sub-sample results. Averaging those ourselves would re-create USDA's statistics and risk errors, so it is left out. SR Legacy + CoFID cover our needs; an older Foundation release with the standard layout can be added later if a gap appears.
